scope: Resolve the policy premise behind LibreCAD_3 PR #456's Intel macOS bottle-only CI failure.

sources.finding: Intel x86_64 macOS is Tier 3; Homebrew has stopped building new Intel bottles and expects to remove Intel support in or after September 2027. The page recommends MacPorts but says MacPorts does not provide a full binary set for Intel Tahoe.
Python 3.14 port exists; the catalog reports Intel Tahoe/Sequoia build artifacts. This alone does not prove the application dependency closure.
Qt 6 base port exists and the catalog lists Intel Tahoe and Sequoia artifacts. This alone does not prove the application dependency closure.
The displayed Boost shim identifies Boost 1.76 via boost176, so equivalence with the current LibreCAD_3 Boost build requirement is not established.

conclusion: The current Intel Homebrew --force-bottle job cannot be made durable by refreshing formula metadata. MacPorts is a possible binary provider but is unqualified and not shown to provide a complete compatible dependency closure.
policy: Do not silently permit Homebrew source-build fallback.
Do not mark the current Intel job advisory or promote Intel package qualification from partial ports availability.
Determine whether Intel remains a required release target.
If retained, enumerate every direct/transitive dependency, version, binary archive, license notice, architecture and origin digest under a supported provider before implementing provider changes.
If retired, change the supported platform matrix and CI policy explicitly and validate the remaining supported targets.
limitations: No complete MacPorts closure audit was performed.
No MacPorts archive signature, source revision, licensing inventory, or deployed Mach-O origin was validated.
This policy research does not qualify Intel or alter DWG/DXF support claims.
next: Resolve Intel target status as a release-policy decision; if it remains required, audit the full MacPorts binary closure against the exact LibreCAD_3 dependency set and provenance gates before making code changes.
